description: In a post-apocalyptic world, where a biotech virus has transformed humans into violent cannibals, a survivor hides in an isolated cabin. But when a stranger arrives with a story of hope, she must choose whether to stay or escape through a zombie-infested forest.

title: Fruitvale Station
description: When 22-year-old Oscar Grant (Michael B. Jordan) wakes up on December 31, 2008, he’s ready to begin working on his resolution to change his ways and be a better son, boyfriend and father. Although change can be difficult, his hard work starts to pay off.

title: Hart's War
description: Bruce Willis stars as an imprisoned officer who refuses to give up his fight to defeat the Nazis in this “absorbing” (Roger Ebert) WWII adventure. When Col. McNamara (Willis) is held captive in a German POW camp, he’s resolved to keep on fighting, even from behind enemy lines.

title: High Rollers
description: A master thief must pull off a dangerous casino heist when his nemesis kidnaps his lover. Caught between rival criminals and FBI pursuit, he risks all to save her and score big.

title: Honeymoon In Vegas
description: James Caan, Nicolas Cage and Sarah Jessica Parker are three sides of a deliriously funny triangle in this refreshing comedy that hits the jackpot with big laughs! Jack Singer (Cage) is terrified of commitment but even more terrified of losing his beautiful fiancé Betsy (Parker).

title: Lions for Lambs
description: Robert Redford, Tom Cruise, and Meryl Streep star in this powerful and provocative film, which investigates the complexities of war... and its consequences for two soldiers fighting to survive on the other side of the world, in Afghanistan.

title: Lords Of Anarchy
description: Based on an acclaimed novel, 'Lords of Anarchy' follows the life of sixteen-year-old Mickey Smalley and as his mother, Eva. After Mickey’s father, Roman, becomes the latest in a line of men to run out on the family, he is forced to step up.

title: Lost Transmissions
description: Schizophrenic music producer Theo Ross (Simon Pegg) is determined to make singer-songwriter Hannah (Juno Temple) a star. Worried that Theo is skipping his medication, Hannah sets out to help her erratic friend.

title: Love After Love
description: An uplifting story of love after loss. Following the death of a college professor, a wife and son explore new beginnings.

title: Meteor: Day One
description: In the mid-1500’s a pair of Spanish explorers set out into Mexico to find a mysterious dial that once belonged to Montezuma, and which is said to have the ability to bring meteors from space crashing down to Earth.

title: Money Plane
description: A professional thief with $40 million in debt and his family's life on the line must commit one final heist - rob a futuristic airborne casino filled with the world's most dangerous criminals.

title: Ozi: Voice of the Forest
description: Meet Ozi, a little orphan orangutan who’s about to go on an epic adventure to save her forest home.

title: Princess and the Dragon
description: Discover the enchanting secrets of the magic mirror! While wandering around the secret chambers of the castle on her seventh birthday, Princess Barbara finds a magic book which transports her to wonderland.

title: Quantum Supremacy
description: In a future threatened by rogue robots and an all-powerful AI, Captain Monroe and his crew race to prevent humanity's downfall in Quantum Supremacy.

title: Rally Road Racers
description: To save his Granny's home, a slow loris with a need for speed must overcome his lack of experience to win an international car race across China.

title: Rogue Hostage
description: An ex-military operative, now working as a child protective services officer, must save an immigrant child from a dangerous criminal who has trapped them, and other hostages, in a super store on Black Friday.

title: Saint Clare
description: In a small town a solitary woman is haunted by voices that lead her to assassinate ill intended people and get away with it, until her last kill sucks her down a rabbit hole riddled with corruption, trafficking and visions from the beyond.

title: Saint Frances
description: Wayward 30-something Bridget can't seem to get a handle on her stalled career or flailing love life, until she takes a summer job nannying Frances, a precocious 6-year-old whose simple wisdoms just might set Bridget back on track.

title: Saints & Soldiers
description: Four American soldiers and one Brit fighting in Europe during World War II struggle to return to Allied territory after being separated from U.S. forces during the historic Malmedy Massacre.

title: Six Degrees Of Separation
description: Posing as the son of Sidney Poitier, Paul (Will Smith) deftly penetrates the world of art-dealing New York urbanites Ouisa and Flan Kittredge (Stockard Channing, Donald Sutherland). But as Paul’s tangled web of dropped names and near-fame begins to unravel...

title: Something in the Dirt
description: When neighbours John and Levi witness supernatural events in their Los Angeles apartment, they realise documenting the paranormal could inject some fame and fortune into their wasted lives.

title: Space Ranger Origin
description: A group of Space Rangers must protect the universe from extinction.

title: Strictly Confidential
description: A haunted young woman finds herself drawn into a world of seduction, duplicity and betrayal as she desperately tries to uncover the mystery surrounding her best friend's suicide.

title: Take Back
description: Zara and Brian are living the perfect small-town life when Zara heroically foils a robbery and becomes headline news. This unwanted notoriety draws elements of Zara's mysterious past back into her life, putting the lives of her family in danger.

title: The Canterville Ghost
description: In this fun and spooky adventure, the ghost of Sir Simon Canterville has been roaming his castle, searching for a brave descendant who will release him from the Canterville curse. When an American family moves in and finds the ghost amusing, a young girl in the family can release him if she dares.

title: The Elfkins
description: Gnomeo & Juliet meets Trolls, The Elfkins is a funny, colourful and uplifting story about being accepted no matter how big or small you are.

title: The Ice Princess
description: When the brave fire dragon Tabaluga meets beautiful ice princess Lilli, they become instant friends. To save their world from a tyrannical snowman, they have to stick together and embark on an exciting journey. An inspiring tale all about the power of friendship and the victory of love over hate.

title: The Immortal Wars: Rebirth
description: Rebirth takes place during the early brutal stages of Dominion Industries. In this story watch Olive and other deviants undergo a series of deadly experiments lead by Laurie Harvey and her team.

title: The Jungle Bunch World Tour
description: As the jungle creatures brace for the impending rainy season, a mysterious pink foam blankets their home, triggering The Jungle Bunch to unite in a thrilling race against the clock.

title: The Oak Room
description: During a raging snowstorm, a drifter (RJ Mitte) offers to settle a debt, with a grizzled bartender, by telling him a story. The night's events quickly spiral into a dark tale of deceit, mistaken identity and shocking violence.

title: The Pink Panther
description: When a star soccer coach is murdered and his priceless Pink Panther diamond stolen, France is in an uproar. Fortunately, Inspector Jacques Clouseau (Steve Martin) is on the case with his trusted partner Gilbert Ponton (Jean Reno). Will he seduce the pop diva, Xania (Beyoncé Knowles)?

title: The Pink Panther 2
description: When legendary treasures from around the world are stolen, including the priceless Pink Panther diamond, Clouseau is assigned to a dream team of international detectives who are under pressure to bring the master thief to justice before he strikes again.

title: Tim Travers and the Time Travelers Paradox
description: What happens if you travel back in time and eliminate your younger self? Terminally bored mad genius Tim Travers seeks to find the answer and unravel the time traveler's paradox. The Result? A crazy comedic adventure beyond comprehension.

title: Tom Clancy's Without Remorse
description: An elite Navy SEAL (Michael B. Jordan) uncovers an international conspiracy while seeking justice for the murder of his pregnant wife in "Without Remorse," the explosive origin story of action hero John Clark – one of the most popular characters in author Tom Clancy’s Jack Ryan universe.

title: Toy Gun
description: Normally quiet and unassuming, Ruggero decides to rob a bank, in an attempt to impress his ex-wife. Pulling off the heist with only a toy gun, Ruggero looks to have gotten away with the perfect crime. Or has he?

title: Welcome to The Darkness
description: In 2003, British glam-rockers The Darkness took the world by storm with their hit single "I Believe In A Thing Called Love". This is their story.

title: When We Get There
description: Two brothers set out on a 2,000-mile road trip to find their father, confronting uncertain futures, fragile relationships and the meaning of family along the way.

title: Wolf Manor
description: During filming of a British, low-budget horror movie, the cast and crew begin disappearing. As the full moon rises, the nightmare begins, and the werewolf devours.

title: Zookeeper
description: In this warm-hearted comedy, the animals at one particular zoo love their caretaker, Griffin Keyes (Kevin James). But when Griffin decides the only way he can get a girl in his life is to find a more glamorous job, the animals, in a panic, break their time-honored code of silence...
